## Tidepool Landing Page — Build Plan

**Design system:** Deep tide teal (#0E3A3F) replaces forest green; coral stays (#FF6B5B) — thematically earned as anemone/reef. Background: sandy off-white (#F7F3EC). Headlines in a warm serif (Fraunces), body/UI in Inter, annotations and quotes in IBM Plex Mono.

**1. Hero (two-column)**
- Left rail: vertical week-timeline, Mon–Sun as nodes, each with a live chip ("Design sync 10am," "Ship v0.3"). Today's node enlarged with coral ring. Sticky through scroll.
- Right: run-on single-sentence headline matching the library pattern: *"Bring your whole team around one living plan that shifts the moment anything changes, remembers how long work actually takes, and quietly clears the fog from Monday morning so nobody walks into the week guessing."*
- Hand-drawn coral arrow from headline to a tilted app screenshot, scribbled mono annotation: "your week, live →"
- CTAs: coral "Start your week" + ghost "Watch the 90-sec tour."

**2. Trust strip:** muted logos, one line: "1,400 small teams plan here."

**3. How it works:** three cards following the week's rhythm — *Set it (Monday), Watch it shift (Wednesday), Close the loop (Friday)*. Hand-drawn icons on sand panels.

**4. Feature deep-dives (2, alternating):** shared team timeline view; auto-carryover of unfinished work into next week. Screenshots sit on soft sand-colored cards with teal captions.

**5. Monospace pull quote:** keep the pattern — oversized coral quotation mark, quote in IBM Plex Mono: *"We killed our Monday standup. Tidepool had already told everyone."* — attribution with small avatar.

**6. CTA band:** full-bleed deep teal, serif line: *"Your week, at low tide."* Coral button repeats.

**7. Footer:** sitemap links, mono changelog line ("v0.9 — weekly digest ships"), small decorative tide-chart motif as brand signature.

## Tidepool Landing Page — Revised Build Plan

**What changed:** the week-timeline is no longer hero decoration — it's the page's structural spine. Every section anchors to a weekday node and doubles as scroll navigation. Copy gets concrete throughout, and mobile/contrast are now specified.

**Design system:** Tide teal (#0E3A3F), coral (#FF6B5B), sand (#F7F3EC). Coral strictly for interaction — buttons, live markers, annotations — never body text (fails contrast on sand). Fraunces headlines, Inter body, IBM Plex Mono for annotations, quotes, meta. Motion stays subtle: the coral marker eases between nodes; "today" breathes gently.

**1. Hero — Monday (two-column)**
- Left rail: sticky vertical Mon–Sun spine. Each node anchors a page section; a coral "you are here" marker tracks scroll. Hovering a node previews that section's day label. Mobile: collapses to a horizontal day strip under the nav.
- Right: headline as one unbroken run-on sentence: *"Bring your whole team around one living plan that shifts the moment anything changes, remembers how long the work actually takes, and quietly clears the fog from Monday morning so nobody starts the week guessing."*
- Hand-drawn coral arrow to a tilted screenshot; mono scribble beside it: "wed 11:04 — the design sync just moved itself."
- CTAs: coral "Start your week," ghost "Watch the 90-second tour."

**2. Trust strip (thin, unlabeled):** "1,400 teams between 3 and 30 people plan here" + muted logos. A sizing claim beats a generic logo wall.

**3. How it works — Tuesday:** three sand-panel cards tracing one week: *Plan Monday (15 minutes), Watch it move (drag anything; dependencies follow), Close Friday (the recap writes itself).* Hand-drawn icons, mono captions.

**4. Feature deep-dives — Wednesday:** two alternating spreads. (a) The shared week grid, with a coral highlight showing a task auto-shifting Tue→Wed; copy names the enemy: "the plan that died in a doc." (b) The Friday recap, shown as a real Slack artifact, not a product shot.

**5. Pull quote — Thursday:** oversized coral quote mark, IBM Plex Mono: *"We cancelled our Monday standup. Tidepool had already told everyone."* Paired with one hard metric: "3.2 hours back per person, per week."

**6. CTA band — Friday:** full-bleed teal, serif line *"Your week, at low tide,"* coral button repeated, sub-line "Free for teams up to 5 — no card."

**7. Footer — the weekend:** sitemap, mono changelog ("v0.9 — weekly digest ships"), tide-chart motif, small sign-off: *"Tide's out. Back Monday."*
